definitions.explanation: Experiencing or doing something for the first time.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}に{初|はじ}めて{来|き}ました。
examples.english: I came to Japan for the first time.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{会|あ}った{時|とき}
お{寿司|すし}を{初|はじ}めて{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate sushi for the first time.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{雪|ゆき}を{見|み}た{子供|こども}はとても{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: The child who saw snow for the first time was very happy.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めての{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}で、{何|なに}もかもが{新鮮|しんせん}に{感|かん}じられた。
examples.english: On my first trip abroad, everything felt fresh and new.

notes:
{初|はじ}めて is an adverb meaning 'for the first time.' It indicates the speaker's first experience of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {初|はじ}めて + verb: {初|はじ}めて{食|た}べた (ate for the first time)
- {初|はじ}めての + noun: {初|はじ}めての{経験|けいけん} (first experience), {初|はじ}めてのデート (first date)
- Verb て-form + {初|はじ}めて: {来|き}て{初|はじ}めて{分|わ}かった (only after coming did I understand)

GREETING:
{初|はじ}めまして (Nice to meet you) derives from this word. Used when meeting someone for the first time.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最初|さいしょ}に: first (in a sequence), initially
- {初|はじ}めて: for the first time (emphasizes newness of experience)

NOTE:
Do not confuse with {始|はじ}めて from {始|はじ}める (to begin). {初|はじ}めて uses the kanji {初|はつ} (first/new).
